0x0008C2.en: 「As I am now...@　this is my limit...!」

0x000933.en: 「Ngh! This is as far as I go...!!」

0x0009BB.en: 「Damn it!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x000B1C.en: 「Oh dear...@　how uncool of me, honestly!」

0x000B90.en: 「Grr, so this is where it ends!」

0x000C20.en: 「Screwing up in a place like this...!@　This is no fun...」

0x000C74.en: 「I blew it...!@　No choice but to bail...」

0x000DC5.en: 「This is the end... The rest is up to you.」

0x000DF7.en: 「Damn it...!@ So this is the end!」

0x000E33.en: 「Grr! You got the better of me...」

0x000E71.en: 「No good, we're too badly hit... Retreating!」

0x000EBE.en: 「Well, this is a fix. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000EFC.en: 「Kyah! I leave the rest to you!」

0x000F43.en: 「To think the Granzon... could be shot down...」

0x000FEE.en: 「Gah...! So I'm the falling star this time...! Ejecting!」

0x00112A.en: 「Nn... guh! Is this as far as I go...!」

0x0011DE.en: 「I'm sorry... the rest is up to you.」

0x001213.en: 「Damn it! Is this the limit of my strength...!」

0x001257.en: 「I can't fight any longer! Falling back!」

0x0012FF.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@ I'm still green...!」

0x00134D.en: 「No good, I can't hold on! Retreating!」

0x0013C6.en: 「Sorry!@ I'm pulling out of this one...!」

0x001437.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x001475.en: 「Well, well. So this is the end.」

0x0014A4.en: 「I can't go on. I'll be taking my leave.」

0x00152F.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll pull back for now...!」

0x001A04.en: 「...Lord Yomogi, the Steel Dragon Squadron has broken through the Gate of Baral.@ They will reach Baral's Garden shortly.」

0x001AA4.en: (That they could defeat Lord Guanglong, Lady Kanan, and my own master...)

0x001B00.en: (Is that the judgment of the god of Baral... what they call destiny? Yet the Total Human Deliverance Plan cannot be stopped now.)

0x001B86.en: (The paradise mortals have longed for since ancient times, the promised land... Shangri-La, the last utopia, will manifest.)

0x001C31.en: 「Her purification is complete. She is with the god now.」

0x001C5C.en: 「So... our role is all but finished.@ You have served well. I shall free your souls now.」

0x001D30.en: (Master...@ the final task you gave me...)

0x001D7D.en: (The war of god and man over the last paradise...@ yes, the outcome of the Sealing War...)

0x001E29.en: 「This world is the haven of those who fled calamity...@ It must never be lost...」

0x001E91.en: 「Upon those living in paradise... the protection of Gan Eden...」

0x001EDA.en: 「Upon those who guard paradise... the power of Gan Eden...」

0x001F1D.en: 「Guardians of paradise...@ the swords I have chosen, the Steel Dragon Squadron... bring them to me...」

0x001F92.en: 「Captain, the ship has entered the airspace above Baral's Garden.」

0x001FD5.en: 「And the Gate of Baral behind us?」

0x002000.en: 「It closed the moment we passed through.@ A barrier now covers the airspace within 20km of Baral's Garden.」

0x0020B1.en: 「So there's nowhere left to run.@ Is a barrier deployed around the structures too?」

0x00212C.en: 「Keep air and ground alert at maximum.@ This is the enemy's stronghold. Anything could happen.」

0x0021CC.en: 「The calm before the storm, as they say.@ And when you talk like that...」

0x002234.en: 「Custos and others emerging from Baral's Garden in large numbers!」

0x00229C.en: 「Well now, the final act at last.」

0x0022C7.en: 「Three servants at the tower.@ If a storm were blowing, it'd be perfect. Right, Ranshao?」

0x00233F.en: 「Why do you say such things to me?」

0x002370.en: 「No idle chatter, Mio.@ Whatever else it is, our foe calls itself a god.@ This won't be settled by half measures.」

0x002400.en: 「Oh, I'm looking forward to it.@ Just what kind of thing is going to show up?」

0x00245C.en: 「This is hardly the time to be saying@ such things, is it?」

0x0024C1.en: 「Not the time at all, indeed and forsooth.」

0x002501.en: 「Lamia, dear, it's rubbing off, it's rubbing off.」

0x002545.en: 「Now, now, don't get so worked up.@ Better than being too tense to say a word.」

0x0025EA.en: 「Irui was deceived by Guanglong and the others, controlled by Gan Eden...@ There's no way that child sealed the Earth...@ no way at all...!」

0x0026C4.en: 「Those things... they're not coming at us?」

0x002708.en: 「They didn't send out that many@ just to give us a warm welcome.」

0x00279F.en: 「Yeah, we watch and wait. All units, stay sharp.」

0x0027EC.en: 「Still, I don't see any of the Classics around.@ Was that last batch the whole lot?」

0x002854.en: 「What do you make of it, Kukuru?」

0x00287C.en: 「I cannot say...@ But Taihoku's disciple, Yomogi, should@ still remain in Baral's Garden.」

0x00290D.en: 「They were once stone statues enshrined in the Baral temple.@ They began to move when the master awoke.」

0x00298D.en: 「Those things, like the three servants, were something@ even Guanglong and the others couldn't control.」

0x0029EC.en: 「In other words, mobile weapons under Gan Eden's command.」

0x002A26.en: 「Kukuru, have you ever seen Gan Eden yourself?」

0x002A72.en: 「No.@ The only ones allowed into the temple's depths@ were Guanglong, and perhaps...」

0x002AFD.en: 「When that child was brought to Baral's Garden,@ how did she seem?」

0x002B5C.en: 「...I never saw the shrine maiden in Baral's Garden.」

0x002BDA.en: 「Yeah, I know. I feel one hell of a powerful presence.」

0x002C20.en: 「But this presence... it slips gently@ into your heart...」

0x002C70.en: 「Not hostile... more like it's@ wrapping itself around us...」

0x002CBD.en: 「But let your guard down, and it'll swallow you whole...」

0x002CFA.en: (Whoever this presence belongs to... it's almost like...)

0x002D6E.en: (What is this... I even feel a kind of nostalgia...)

0x002DA8.en: (I-I'm different...! It's eating away at me...!?)

0x002DE5.en: 「High energy reading atop the tower in Baral's Garden!!」

0x002E25.en: 「It moved! All cannons, prepare to fire!」

0x002E56.en: 「C-Captain! There's an image on the monitor!」

0x002FED.en: 「Yes, Ibis...@ this is my... true form...」

0x00304C.en: 「Everyone in the Steel Dragon Squadron...@ I have been waiting for you...」

0x0030A8.en: 「The Earth is now sealed by my power...@ My chosen swords... let us protect the last paradise@ together with Gan Eden...」

0x00315C.en: 「Chosen...@ Then you contacted us on purpose?」

0x0031BE.en: 「Yes...@ Gan Eden commanded me to seek out swords with strong@ power and hearts, to fight and protect the Earth...」

0x00328E.en: 「Yes...@　And I have been watching you closely, to see if@　you have what it takes to be a sword.」

0x00331C.en: 「So that's why@　she was so reluctant to leave the ship.」

0x003382.en: 「...Just what is Gan Eden?@　Where did you people come from?」

0x0033E1.en: 「The wish of the ancients... that is what shaped us...@　Gan Eden is a man-made god... Baral, its throne...」

0x003486.en: 「The ancients... you mean the ones@　who built Fabula Foris?」

0x0034E8.en: 「In ancient times...@　to escape a great disaster coming from beyond the sky...@　Gan Eden and Baral were created...」

0x00357B.en: 「Beyond the sky...?@　This great disaster, do you mean the Ruina?」

0x0035C5.en: 「Or the horde of demons the Light Dragon spoke of...?」

0x003608.en: 「The dark gods and gods of destruction who once@　drove all living things to the brink of extinction...」

0x003676.en: 「Gan Eden exists to escape the calamity they bring...@　to guard this world, chosen as@　the final paradise...」

0x003715.en: 「The final paradise... a chosen world, huh.@　So you're saying Gan Eden and the Garden of Baral@　aren't native to Earth?」

0x0037AE.en: 「Then where are they from?@　Don't tell me it's a world tied to you lot.」

0x003819.en: 「You flatter us.@　If we had something like that, we'd have been@　rulers of the galaxy ages ago.」

0x003891.en: 「Earth has long been subject to@　the interference of many...」

0x0038F9.en: 「Time and again disaster came, fierce battles@　were waged... and the world itself was wounded...」

0x003986.en: 「Great power breeds calamity and spreads it...@　You, the Steel Dragon Squadron, are no different...」

0x003A43.en: 「If you fall in battle...@　if a power greater than yours appears...」

0x003AC3.en: 「Then this paradise will meet@　its end.」

0x003B13.en: 「Like hell we'd ever let that happen!」

0x003B4A.en: 「No matter how strong the enemy,@　we'll fight to protect this world!」

0x003BED.en: 「Your lives are not infinite...@　Even if your power can protect Earth now...」

0x003C70.en: 「From here on...@　to protect this world for all eternity@　is impossible...」

0x003CDF.en: 「True, a human life is short.@　But that will is passed down,@　carried on across the ages.」

0x003D5D.en: 「Even when our lives run their course,@　there will always be those who inherit our will.」

0x003DCB.en: 「...I understand that...@　For I too inherited that will and power@　from Gan Eden... the one also called Augustus...」

0x003EAD.en: 「Augustus...@　the name of the first emperor of Rome.」

0x003EFD.en: 「So this emperor's the one behind it all!」

0x003F53.en: 「It's a different being that shares the name.」

0x003F90.en: 「Yes, it goes by many other names too...@　but it was the first Psychodriver.」

0x003FFB.en: 「Long ago... there were those given@　the blood of Psychodrivers by Gan Eden...」

0x00406F.en: 「And they were charged with a mission:@　to protect this world in place of Gan Eden@　and its three divine servants...」

0x004102.en: 「But over long ages... mingling with humanity@　thinned their blood...」

0x004173.en: 「Even so... on occasion, through atavism...@　those with the power appeared.」

0x00427F.en: 「Then she isn't a being created by Gan Eden...」

0x0042F4.en: 「So Irui's being controlled by Gan Eden...!」

0x00433A.en: 「No, that's not it.@　I stand with Gan Eden of my own will.」

0x0043FF.en: 「I've watched your battles all this time...@　You fought to protect this world...@　to protect so many people...」

0x0044A7.en: 「Fearless of harm, heedless of your own lives...@　you kept on fighting...」

0x00450C.en: 「Of course. That is our mission...@　We are the sword and shield of those without one.」

0x00457D.en: 「I don't want to be protected. I want to be@　the strength that protects... and...」
